promise: "AI that can match humans at any task will be here in five to 10 years"
description: Hassabis repeatedly predicted AGI in roughly a 5-10 year window, later tightening to 'around 2030, possibly as early as 2029' (May 2026 interviews). Long-dated timeline, still pending and unverifiable.
evidence: Nov 2025: Hassabis reiterated 5-10 years (Times of India)
May 2026: 'DeepMind CEO predicts AGI in 2030' (Axios); 'as early as 2029' (GIGAZINE)

promise: Reduce the net carbon intensity of our energy products by 20% by 2030 and 45% by 2035, versus 2016 (net zero by 2050).
description: Shell's 2021 Energy Transition Strategy set 20% (2030) and 45% (2035) intensity cuts. On 14 June 2023 CEO Wael Sawan scrapped the 2035 target outright and cut the 2030 target to 9-12% - the most high-profile corporate climate target reversal of its era (reneged before the deadline).
evidence: 14 June 2023 update: 2035 target removed; 2030 target weakened from 20% to 9-12%
Sawan also dropped Shell's plan to reduce oil production every year through the decade (Wikipedia: Wael Sawan)
Court-ordered 45% cut (Milieudefensie) later overturned on appeal, Nov 2024
